user.title: HA Pet Care
user.description: Track vaccines, dewormers, exams, baths, grooming and vet visits for your pets. After setup, add your pets by selecting Configure on the integration.

add_record.name: Add record
add_record.description: Registers a vaccine, dewormer, exam, bath, grooming or vet visit for a pet.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was done. Defaults to today.

description.name: Description
description.description: Short description, for example the vaccine name or the clinic.

next_due.name: Next due date
next_due.description: When the next one is due (booster, next bath, return visit). For vaccines and dewormers it replaces the automatic date (1 year and 6 months after the last one).

remove_record.name: Remove record
remove_record.description: Deletes a record from a pet's history.

record_id.name: Record ID
record_id.description: ID of the record, found in the sensor's history attribute or returned by Add record.

set_photo.name: Set photo
set_photo.description: Sets the profile photo of a pet from an image file.

path.name: Path
path.description: Path to a JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF file inside your Home Assistant config folder.

add_weight.name: Add weight
add_weight.description: Registers the weight of a pet to track its growth.

date.name: Date
date.description: When the pet was weighed. Defaults to today.

remove_weight.name: Remove weight
remove_weight.description: Deletes a weight entry from a pet's history.

record_id.name: Record ID
record_id.description: ID of the weight entry, found in the weight sensor's history attribute or returned by Add weight.

invalid_next_due.message: The next due date cannot be before the record date.

invalid_weight.message: The weight must be greater than 0 and at most 200 kg.
